PLUGIN_DB_ADDRESS_FORMATS.doc: The one address form of a plugin: <format>:<id>, or clap@<sha256>:<id> when several files share one CLAP id, the sha256 that of the .clap file. An LV2 address carries no sha256: the bundle rule makes one bundle the plugin. A path is never part of an address, so a session keeps its plugins on another machine. The format is one of these words; an id is the plugin's own, its CLAP id or its LV2 URI, and a CLAP id that begins with '/' is a path and no address.

clap.doc: a CLAP plugin: the id is the plugin descriptor's id

lv2.doc: an LV2 plugin: the id is the plugin's URI

PLUGIN_DB_BUNDLE_RULES.doc: Which LV2 bundle is the plugin, when several bundles of the search path name it: the one rule in force, and the only word of this item. A bundle realises the plugin when its manifest names the plugin with an lv2:binary; one that only names it (a MOD GUI, a preset bundle) complements it. The candidates are the realising bundles, or, when none realises it, the bundles that name it.

newestVersion.doc: of the candidates, the one whose manifest gives the plugin the highest lv2:minorVersion, then the highest lv2:microVersion, a version not stated counting as 0; of equal versions the first in the search path, its directories in order and the bundles of one directory in byte order of their names. This is lilv's rule, so the host loads the bundle plugin-db pins.

PLUGIN_DB_LAYERS.doc: The layers of an entry, each with one writer. An entry is a directory of the store, and each layer is one file of it, the word and .json, in the envelope data/store.schema.json declares. The entry is the join of its layers at read time and is never stored.

declared.doc: meaning, units, travel and defaults, installed with the package by the plugin's owner, read only

scanned.doc: identity, controls, ports, presets and GUI evidence, written by plugin-qualify under its runner

pinned.doc: the files of the plugin with their digests and the layout fingerprint, written through plugin-db

measured.doc: latency, cost and behaviour per rate and quantum with the conditions, written by the probes; may be wiped

judged.doc: the record: verdict, conditions and what it was measured under, written by plugin-qualify's judgement

reference.doc: a record from a reference machine, installed by plugin-db-qualification, read only

corrected.doc: renames, hidden controls and scale a person chose, written by the override module

warnedOverride.doc: a person's choice to run a refused plugin anyway, alone; it binds the pin it was written for and does not survive an upgrade

observed.doc: crash and xrun history, written by plugin-hostd and the engine

PLUGIN_DB_FILES.doc: What the check found of the plugin's files against its pinned layer, as rpm -V reports an attribute. Could not test is never same.

same.doc: every file the plugin loads is held by the pin and has the digest the pin holds

changed.doc: a file differs from its digest, is gone, is new, or another bundle is now the plugin

absent.doc: the plugin is in no file of the search path any more, or its pinned file is gone

couldNotTest.doc: there is no pinned layer, or a file or the pin could not be read

PLUGIN_DB_LAYOUT.doc: What the check found of the plugin's parameter layout against the layout fingerprint of its pinned layer.

same.doc: the layout has the pinned fingerprint: the files are the pinned bytes, or a host found the pinned fingerprint

changed.doc: a host found another fingerprint than the pinned one

notYetKnown.doc: the pin holds no layout, or the files changed and no host has found their layout yet

PLUGIN_DB_RECORD.doc: Whether the judged layer, the record, answers for these bytes on this machine now.

current.doc: it was written for the pinned bytes and layout, and nothing of PLUGIN_DB_RECORD_CHANGES makes it stale

text.en: Its record is current.
text.ca: El seu registre és vigent.

stale.doc: it exists, and a change of PLUGIN_DB_RECORD_CHANGES, or files that could not be tested, keep it from answering

text.en: Its record no longer applies.
text.ca: El seu registre ja no s'aplica.

text.en: It has no record.
text.ca: No té registre.

PLUGIN_DB_RECORD_ACTIONS.doc: What a change since a record was written asks for, each in the group of PLUGIN_DB_RECORD it leaves the record in.

fullPath.doc: scan, pin, measure and judge again

text.en: Scan, measure and judge it again.
text.ca: Cal escanejar-lo, mesurar-lo i jutjar-lo de nou.

measureHere.doc: measure and judge on this class of machine; the record stays valid for its own class

text.en: Measure it on this machine.
text.ca: Cal mesurar-lo en aquesta màquina.

convert.doc: convert the record to the schema in force, with no new measurement

text.en: Convert the record; nothing is measured again.
text.ca: Cal convertir el registre; no es torna a mesurar res.

rejudge.doc: judge the measurements again, automatically, with no new measurement

text.en: Judge the measurements again; nothing is measured again.
text.ca: Cal tornar a jutjar les mesures; no es torna a mesurar res.

remeasureBackground.doc: the record stays current, shown as measured under the host it names, and is measured again in the background

text.en: The record still applies; it is measured again in the background.
text.ca: El registre encara s'aplica; es torna a mesurar en segon pla.

PLUGIN_DB_RECORD_CHANGES.doc: What may have changed since a record was written, each the row of the staleness table with the action it asks for. When several changed, the first in this order answers.

files.doc: the plugin's files are not the bytes the record was written for, or could not be tested

text.en: Its files changed.
text.ca: Els seus fitxers han canviat.

layout.doc: the parameter layout is not the one the record was written for, or is not yet known

text.en: Its parameters changed.
text.ca: Els seus paràmetres han canviat.

hostingChange.doc: the host is a release that declares a hosting change: its hosting epoch is past the record's. The host's owner declares it in the contract; no reader guesses

text.en: The host changed how it hosts plugins.
text.ca: L'amfitrió ha canviat com allotja els connectors.

machineClass.doc: this machine is of another class than the record's

text.en: This is another kind of machine.
text.ca: Aquesta és un altre tipus de màquina.

schema.doc: the record schema in force is not the record's

text.en: The record format changed.
text.ca: El format del registre ha canviat.

rules.doc: the judgement rules in force are not the ones the record was judged by

text.en: The qualification rules changed.
text.ca: Les regles de qualificació han canviat.

hostVersion.doc: the host is a normal release other than the one the record was measured under

text.en: The host is another release.
text.ca: L'amfitrió és una altra versió.

PLUGIN_DB_STATES.doc: What a plugin is, from its attributes, its record, a shipped record and a warned override, answered by one function and by no reader for itself. There is no upgraded and no crashed state: new bytes have no record, so they are unqualified. Each state is in the group of PLUGIN_DB_RUNS it runs as; a refusal a warned override covers runs alone instead.

unqualified.doc: no current record, for any reason: runs alone in its own limited worker, never grouped; shown as not qualified, with the reason

text.en: Not qualified: it runs alone, in a worker of its own.
text.ca: No qualificat: s'executa sol, en un procés propi.

qualified.doc: a current record whose verdict allows it and whose conditions are met here: runs as the verdict and the placement rules allow

text.en: Qualified: it runs as its record allows.
text.ca: Qualificat: s'executa com permet el seu registre.

isolatedOnly.doc: a current record that says it is safe only alone: runs alone

text.en: Qualified to run alone only.
text.ca: Qualificat només per executar-se sol.

conditionsUnmet.doc: a current record with no cell for this rate or quantum, or a condition that fails here: runs alone, as unqualified

text.en: Its record does not cover this machine's settings: it runs alone.
text.ca: El seu registre no cobreix la configuració d'aquesta màquina: s'executa sol.

refused.doc: a current record or a shipped refusal says refused: not loaded, unless a warned override says run alone

text.en: Refused: it is not loaded.
text.ca: Refusat: no es carrega.

absent.doc: the files are gone: not loaded

text.en: Its files are gone: it is not loaded.
text.ca: Els seus fitxers ja no hi són: no es carrega.

PLUGIN_DB_RUNS.doc: How a state runs at load.

shared.doc: as the verdict and the placement rules allow, in a worker other plugins may share

text.en: Runs in a shared worker.
text.ca: S'executa en un procés compartit.

alone.doc: in its own limited worker, never grouped

text.en: Runs alone, in a worker of its own.
text.ca: S'executa sol, en un procés propi.

notLoaded.doc: not loaded: shown with its reason and its saved values kept; an effect passes audio through, an instrument is silent

text.en: Not loaded: an effect passes audio through, an instrument is silent.
text.ca: No es carrega: un efecte deixa passar l'àudio, un instrument queda en silenci.

PLUGIN_DB_REASONS.doc: Why a plugin is in its state, each in the group of PLUGIN_DB_STATES it explains: what show prints beside the state.

neverPinned.doc: there is no pinned layer: never scanned or never pinned

text.en: It has never been scanned.
text.ca: No s'ha escanejat mai.

measurementPending.doc: pinned, and there is no record yet

text.en: It has not been measured yet.
text.ca: Encara no s'ha mesurat.

couldNotTest.doc: the files or the pin could not be read

text.en: Its files could not be read.
text.ca: No s'han pogut llegir els seus fitxers.

filesChanged.doc: the files are not the pinned bytes

text.en: Its files have changed since they were scanned.
text.ca: Els seus fitxers han canviat des que es van escanejar.

layoutChanged.doc: the layout is not the pinned one

text.en: Its parameters have changed since they were scanned.
text.ca: Els seus paràmetres han canviat des que es van escanejar.

layoutNotYetKnown.doc: the pin holds no layout, so a record cannot bind one

text.en: Its parameters are not known yet.
text.ca: Encara no se'n coneixen els paràmetres.

recordStale.doc: the record is stale for a change of PLUGIN_DB_RECORD_CHANGES, which show names with its action

text.en: Its record no longer applies and it needs measuring again.
text.ca: El seu registre ja no s'aplica i cal tornar-lo a mesurar.

notMeasuredUnderHost.doc: the verdict says alone, and the record was not measured under plugin-hostd, which isolated only needs

text.en: Its record says alone, but it was not measured under plugin-hostd.
text.ca: El seu registre diu sol, però no es va mesurar amb plugin-hostd.

verdictAllows.doc: the record's verdict allows a shared worker and its conditions are met here

text.en: Its record allows a shared worker.
text.ca: El seu registre permet un procés compartit.

verdictIsolated.doc: the record's verdict says it is safe only alone

text.en: Its record says it is safe only alone.
text.ca: El seu registre diu que només és segur sol.

referenceOnly.doc: a shipped record matches the pin and was measured on another class of machine: reference figures only, until measured here

text.en: Measured on another kind of machine: reference figures only.
text.ca: Mesurat en un altre tipus de màquina: només xifres de referència.

noCell.doc: the record has no cell for this rate and quantum

text.en: Its record has no measurement at this rate and quantum.
text.ca: El seu registre no té cap mesura a aquesta freqüència i quàntum.

conditionFails.doc: a condition of the record does not hold here, or is not known here

text.en: A condition of its record does not hold on this machine.
text.ca: Una condició del seu registre no es compleix en aquesta màquina.

recordRefused.doc: the record says refused; the way back is a rescan, a requalification or a warned override that runs it alone

text.en: Its record says refused.
text.ca: El seu registre diu refusat.

shippedRefusal.doc: a shipped record of these bytes says refused, which wins over everything and no warned override overrides

text.en: These files are refused by the record shipped with them.
text.ca: Aquests fitxers els refusa el registre distribuït amb ells.

filesGone.doc: the plugin's files are gone; show names the path that was pinned

text.en: Its files are gone.
text.ca: Els seus fitxers ja no hi són.

PLUGIN_DB_ISOLATION_HOSTS.doc: The hosts a verdict of isolated must have been measured under to make a plugin isolated only: a record that says alone and names another host leaves the plugin unqualified.

pluginHostd.doc: the daemon that hosts plugins for use, in workers of their own

PLUGIN_DB_SOURCES.doc: Where the record that answers comes from, as show prints it.

text.en: No record.
text.ca: Sense registre.

text.en: Measured on this machine.
text.ca: Mesurat en aquesta màquina.

reference.doc: the reference layer: a shipped record, measured on a reference machine

text.en: Measured on a reference machine.
text.ca: Mesurat en una màquina de referència.

PLUGIN_DB_BAR.doc: The bar a person sets for what may load, a user setting on both surfaces whose three words are declared here and read by plugin-hostd and both surfaces: the picker's and the menu's default view follow it. It filters a view and never changes what the reader answers; a refused plugin stays listed with its reason.

qualifiedOnly.doc: only plugins whose state is qualified are offered by default

text.en: Offer qualified plugins only.
text.ca: Oferir només connectors qualificats.

warnOnCrashes.doc: every plugin that is not refused or absent is offered, and only a crash is asked about

text.en: Offer every plugin that is not refused; ask only after a crash.
text.ca: Oferir tots els connectors no refusats; preguntar només després d'una fallada.

loadAll.doc: every plugin is offered, the way back from a refusal included

text.en: Offer every plugin, refused ones included.
text.ca: Oferir tots els connectors, també els refusats.

PLUGIN_DB_LATENCY.doc: Where a measured latency figure stands against the latency line, which plugin-qualify's judgement declares once and writes into the record as latencyLineMs beside the figure of each cell as latencyMs. Over the line is information: the plugin loads. A record without the line, or a cell without the figure, is unmeasured and never a guess.

within.doc: the figure is at or under the line

text.en: Latency within the line.
text.ca: Latència dins del límit.

over.doc: the figure is over the line: shown by the owner's text, and the plugin loads

text.en: Latency over the line; it still loads.
text.ca: Latència per sobre del límit; es carrega igualment.

unmeasured.doc: the record has no line, or the cell has no figure

text.en: Latency not measured.
text.ca: Latència no mesurada.
